moves.name: Snarl

moves.name: Helloooo!
moves.description: Restores an ally’s HP by approximately 60% of its maximum HP. Removes all status conditions from an ally. Removes the flinching, confused, and trapped conditions from an ally. Applies the Enduring effect to an ally. Applies the Gradual Healing effect to an ally when the user’s team has a sync buff.

passives.name: Mutually Assured
